description: Phase A security tail (ROADMAP.md Phase A; prd-pinakes-deep-history-roadmap.md §16). The `security-hardening` pass closed everything else; this is the one open key-custody item: rotate the exposed Gemini / Google-Translate keys and purge `.env` from git history + force-push. PARKED — the roadmap flags this HUMAN-ONLY: rotating live credentials and rewriting/force-pushing shared git history are not autonomous-agent work. Kept as a tracked, runnable-by-a-human tasklist so the item is not lost; it does not block the other Phase-A rows. Scope: credential rotation (out-of-band), git history rewrite, and the ignore/secret-handling hardening left in-tree.

userStories.title: Rotate the exposed credentials (human-only)
userStories.description: Rotate the exposed Gemini/Google-Translate API keys out of band and confirm the old keys are revoked.
acceptanceCriteria: The exposed Gemini and Google-Translate keys are rotated in the provider console and the old keys are confirmed revoked (verified out-of-band, recorded in the security note).
The new keys are supplied only via environment/secret store — never committed — and the app reads them from the environment as before.
A short SECURITY/rotation note records that rotation happened, when, and by whom (no secret values in the note).
userStories.notes: Human-only: credential rotation is out-of-band. Parked so chief never runs it autonomously.

userStories.title: Purge .env from git history + harden ignores (human-only)
userStories.description: Rewrite git history to remove the committed `.env`, force-push, and harden the repo so a secret file cannot be re-committed.
acceptanceCriteria: `.env` is removed from the entire git history (git-filter-repo/BFG) and the rewritten history is force-pushed after coordinating with collaborators.
`.gitignore` covers `.env`/secret files and a committed-secret guard (pre-commit or CI scan) is in place so it cannot recur.
`git log --all -- .env` returns nothing after the rewrite.
userStories.notes: Human-only: history rewrite + force-push require operator judgement and coordination.
